meta.title: Custom Design & Made-to-Measure Orders
meta.description: Order a custom design from DOOVAN: share your idea, fabric and size — our workshop will talk it through and make it to measure.

hero.label: Custom order
hero.heading: Let’s make it yours
hero.description: Some pieces are made to order. Contact us on Instagram, Facebook or by email and our atelier will talk through design, fabric, sizing and timing with you.

product.materialHint: This is the material of the original design. Tell us in your design notes if you’d like a different one.

tell.title: Tell us your idea
tell.text: Describe the design you want and share your measurements in the form below. We turn it into a ready-to-send email.

design.title: We design it with you
design.text: We confirm the design, materials, price and the time it takes to make.

confirm.title: Confirm and we make it
confirm.text: Once you agree on the details, we start making your piece and arrange delivery.

channels.title: Contact us
channels.note: Choose Instagram, Facebook or email — we usually reply within one business day.

design.title: Your personalised design
design.label: Design brief
design.placeholder: Describe your vision: silhouette and fit, preferred fabric or colour, details to add or adjust, and the occasion.

errors.note: Please describe the design you would like
